=== KEY OBSERVATIONS ===
overflowValue:
  Key 287 on Text (typeKey=134)
  Values: 0=visible (default), 1=hidden, 2=clipped, 3=ellipsis, 4=fit
  ellipsis.riv uses value=3 (ellipsis)

alignValue:
  Key 281 on Text (typeKey=134) — NOT in this file's ToC (default=0, left)
  Values: 0=left, 1=right, 2=center

sizingValue:
  Key 284 on Text (typeKey=134)
  Values: 0=auto_width, 1=auto_height, 2=fixed
  ellipsis.riv uses value=2 (fixed) with width=120.53, height=23.50

TextStyleAxis (typeKey=144):
  Key 289 = tag (4-byte ASCII packed as uint32), Key 288 = axisValue (float)
  These encode OpenType variable font axis values. Not yet supported by our builder.

=== BUILDER EQUIVALENCE ===
Our builder cannot replicate TextStyleAxis objects. The conformance test
verifies structural properties (overflow, sizing, alignment) only; byte-exact
output is not expected.
